author: steven5703
body:
Thanks to a pull request by IcyCode, survival games now has 5 rounds before restarting!

How this works:
SG Lobby, people vote for map
Voted map gets played
Game ends
Server automatically cycles to a new SG lobby, where people vote again
Repeat x4

Not a very big update, but I know this was requested so it's worth posting!

If you find issues. please report below or at http://avicus.net/issues
